development.command: npm ci && npx expo prebuild --platform ios && xcodebuild -workspace ios/Atlas.xcworkspace -scheme Atlas -configuration Debug -sdk appletvsimulator -derivedDataPath ios/build CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY=-

preview.command: npm ci && npx expo prebuild --platform ios && xcodebuild -workspace ios/Atlas.xcworkspace -scheme Atlas -configuration Release -sdk appletvsimulator -derivedDataPath ios/build CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY=-

development.command: npm ci && npx expo prebuild --platform android --no-install && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug -PreactNativeArchitectures=x86,x86_64

preview.command: npm ci && npx expo prebuild --platform android --no-install && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease -PreactNativeArchitectures=x86,x86_64
